summary: One neighbor stands for a crowd and asks the council to decide that night rather than delay.
realLife: Residents packed a council meeting over a rezoning; one resident spoke for the group, asked the council to reject the plan that night, and cited traffic, green space, wildlife, and a quiet character.
sources: NewsChannel 9, Dalton neighborhood pushes back on plans for new homes: https://newschannel9.com/news/local/dalton-neighborhood-pushes-back-on-plans-for-hundreds-of-new-homes-near-willowdale-road-windemere-north-dalton-bypass-annexation-rezoning-development
